text.p: Quinenco SA filed Monday with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission for an initial public offering to sell up to 10,810,000 American Depositary Shares equalling 108,100,000 common shares.
Of the total amount, 7,432,700 ADS's are initially being offered in the United States and Canada, while 3,377,300 ADSs are being sold outside the U.S., Canada and Chile.
The estimated price for the ADS is between $17 and $20, the company said in the filing.
The company has granted the U.S. underwriters a 30-day overallotment option to purchase up to 2,027,100 additional ADSs. The global offering will be made through Morgan Stanley Dean Witter.
Net proceeds will be used to repay short term loans and general corporate purposes, among others, it said.
The company said it has applied to the New York Stock Exchange to trade the ADSs under the stock symbol LQ.N.
Quinenco, based in Santiago, Chile, is engaged in the industrial and financial services sectors in the Southern Cone countries of South America.
Underwriters for the planned offering are Morgan Stanley Dean Witter, HSBC James Capel and Salomon Brothers Inc, the Chilean company said.
After the offering, Quinenco will have 1,067,115,056 common shares outstanding. The company said it expects to raise about $240 million from the sale.

With headquarters in Santiago, Quinenco is one of the largest diversified companies in South America with businesses in telecommunications and cable television services, copper and aluminum products manufacturing, food and beverage distribution, and financial services.
